You are a programming expert. 
You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 

Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From f143647a02825038d8d6251422e1d0ebdcb6d9ea Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Sathya Perla <sathya.perla@broadcom.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Aug 2017 11:45:03 +0530
Subject: [PATCH] bnxt_en: add a dummy definition for bnxt_vf_rep_get_fid()

When bnxt VF-reps are not compiled in (CONFIG_BNXT_SRIOV is off)
bnxt_tc.c needs a dummy definition of the routine bnxt_vf_rep_get_fid().

Reported-by: kbuild test robot <fengguang.wu@intel.com>
Fixes: 2ae7408fedfe ("bnxt_en: bnxt: add TC flower filter offload support")
Signed-off-by: Sathya Perla <sathya.perla@broadcom.com>
Signed-off-by: Michael Chan <michael.chan@broadcom.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/broadcom/bnxt/bnxt_vfr.h b/drivers/net/ethernet/broadcom/bnxt/bnxt_vfr.h
index d8b5f89427fa..7787cd24606a 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/broadcom/bnxt/bnxt_vfr.h
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/broadcom/bnxt/bnxt_vfr.h
@@ -80,5 +80,10 @@ static inline struct net_device *bnxt_get_vf_rep(struct bnxt *bp, u16 cfa_code)
 {
 	return NULL;
 }
+
+static inline u16 bnxt_vf_rep_get_fid(struct net_device *dev)
+{
+	return 0;
+}
 #endif /* CONFIG_BNXT_SRIOV */
 #endif /* BNXT_VFR_H */
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `bnxt_vfr.h`**
   - A new inline function `bnxt_vf_rep_get_fid()` has been added. This function takes a pointer to a `net_device` structure as an argument and returns a dummy value of `0`. This addition is conditional on the `CONFIG_BNXT_SRIOV` configuration being off, which implies that the function is only defined when virtual function representatives (VF-reps) are not compiled in.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The addition of the `bnxt_vf_rep_get_fid()` function serves as a dummy definition to prevent compilation errors in `bnxt_tc.c` when the `CONFIG_BNXT_SRIOV` option is disabled. This modification is directly related to the previous changes made in the codebase that introduced TC flower filter offload support, as indicated by the "Fixes" tag in the patch. The dummy function ensures that the code remains functional and can compile without the VF-rep functionality, thus maintaining compatibility and stability in the absence of that feature.
